posts.title: We Bought a Car
posts.description: When people mention that they have read my blog (which happened like three times), they usually recall the posts about living without a car . Since apparently that is the most memorable thing I’ve done in recent years, I decided to write an update. posts.title: A love letter to Husqvarna Vitpilen 701
posts.description: This was the first motorcycle I bought with my heart and not my head. It’s wildly impractical. You cannot take much for trips, since the only practical luggage options are a tank bag and a backpack. The Husqvarna Vitpilen 701 had the most powerful single-cylinder engine ever installed in a mass-production motorcycle, until the Ducati Hypermotard 698 Mono was released last year.
